interface.shortDescription: Read-only host readiness and runtime diagnostics for agentic-plugins
interface.longDescription: L1 framework primitive per ADR-0024. Provides $runtime:doctor as a read-only diagnostic surface for Claude Code and Codex CLI availability, auth state, marketplace/cache/plugin discovery, companion contract compatibility, model/effort resolution observation, companion sandbox/permission readiness, and engineer/orchestrator workflow plus peer-run ledger health. Settings writes, dynamic consensus, context hygiene, and completion footer mutation are intentionally deferred beyond the first doctor PR.
